items.title: Kraft Heinz (KHC) Stock Looks Reasonable Following Oscar Mayer Fix Effort
items.summary: Kraft Heinz has been working through a mix of pressures on its core brands and shoppers' budgets, while the share price has drifted rather than surged. That combination puts a sharp focus on whether the current US$24.27 price is adequately backed by the packaged food giant's sales base. Over the past 3 years the stock has fallen about 14%, which puts the spotlight on whether the business now generates enough revenue to support even this lower share price.
